summary: Your first week of ratings went from mostly 3s and 4s on Wednesday to mostly 5s on Thursday, with only three stories disliked all week (Alberta, the youth radicalisation warning and Shrek 2 Remastered). I've lengthened game tech again (practical first), added why-it-matters and what's-next lines to Australia, kept the story-led delivery you liked, and built the chat around your own answers.
